properties.content: Question: covid 19 timeline symptoms Answer: COVID-19 symptoms can appear 2-14 days after exposure and range from mild to severe. Symptoms may peak around days 8-10, with a plateau around days 11-12. Many individuals begin to see improvement by days 13-14, especially with supportive care. Here's a more detailed breakdown:: - 2-14 Days Post-Exposure: Symptoms can appear anytime within this window. - Early Days: Symptoms may start mild and gradually worsen. - Peak Symptoms (Days 8-10): This is when fever and respiratory distress may be at their most intense. - Symptom Plateau (Days 11-12): Symptoms may stabilize, requiring close monitoring for any changes, according to Medrite. - Gradual Improvement (Days 13-14 and beyond): Many people start to recover around this time, especially with appropriate treatment and care, says Medrite.
